title: Problems of Poverty: An Inquiry into the Industrial Condition of the Poor
summary: "Problems of Poverty: An Inquiry into the Industrial Condition of the Poor" by John A. Hobson is a social and economic analysis written in the late 19th century. Hobson references significant studies, particularly by Charles Booth, to illustrate the extent of poverty in urban areas such as East London.
